# foreman_jobtemplate (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_jobtemplate" "restart_service" {
  name = "Restart service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the jobtemplate to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `job_category` (String)
- `provider_type` (String)
